title: Vampire Survivors
dailyChunk: Complete one 30-minute run with a new character or weapon, then use your unlocks to plan your next build.

title: Inscryption
dailyChunk: Win the next set of card battles, investigate one fresh cabin clue, and end after the next safe transition.

title: Animal Well
dailyChunk: Discover one new tool, hidden passage or collectible cluster, then return to the nearest save telephone.

title: Return of the Obra Dinn
dailyChunk: Examine a new set of memories, identify two crew fates, and check your deductions before stopping.

title: SIGNALIS
dailyChunk: Solve one facility puzzle section and reach the next save room, then organize your limited inventory.

title: Baba Is You
dailyChunk: Solve five new rule-manipulation puzzles, revisiting one difficult stage to find an alternate solution.

title: Pizza Tower
dailyChunk: Clear one floor's stage or improve one P-rank attempt, then stop back at the hub.

title: Cocoon
dailyChunk: Finish one complete orb/world puzzle chain and stop after opening the next area.

title: Chants of Sennaar
dailyChunk: Decode one new set of symbols, validate the notebook entries, and reach the next checkpoint.

title: The Case of the Golden Idol
dailyChunk: Investigate one scene until every identity and event deduction is complete, then move to the case list.

title: Monster Train
dailyChunk: Complete one full climb or a fixed sequence of battles, then adjust your clan and deck plan for tomorrow.

title: Spelunky 2
dailyChunk: Make three deliberate runs practicing the same route, then record which trap or enemy ended each attempt.

title: Bayonetta 3
dailyChunk: Clear one chapter and revisit one combat verse to practice an unfamiliar Demon Slave combination.

title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
dailyChunk: Clear three stages or one world boss, then rescue missed Waddle Dees before returning to town.

title: Metroid Prime Remastered
dailyChunk: Reach the next elevator or major artifact objective, backtrack for one upgrade, and save.

title: Pikmin 4
dailyChunk: Complete one in-game exploration day, rescue castaways, and review your next cave route at the base.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
dailyChunk: Solve one major rift or dungeon puzzle block, test a new echo combination, and save at the next waypoint.

title: Triangle Strategy
dailyChunk: Finish one tactical battle and the associated camp conversations, then prepare your party for the next chapter.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
dailyChunk: Finish one story battle, distribute skill stones and equipment, and save at the next map node.

title: Patapon
dailyChunk: Complete two rhythm-command missions, equip the tribe for its next challenge, and stop at the village.

title: LocoRoco
dailyChunk: Clear two stages and retry one to rescue additional LocoRoco or MuiMui before returning to the stage map.

title: ICO
dailyChunk: Solve one castle-navigation puzzle sequence, escort Yorda to a new safe bench, and save there.

title: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect
dailyChunk: Complete one full story mission, then try one arcade challenge before returning to the menu.

title: Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War
dailyChunk: Complete one sortie from briefing to debrief, assign aircraft and squadron roles, then stop.

title: Jet Set Radio
dailyChunk: Finish one graffiti mission and one optional score run, then stop at the hideout.

title: Skies of Arcadia
dailyChunk: Reach the next town, dungeon save point, or airship objective, then check your equipment and discoveries.

title: Fable II
dailyChunk: Complete one quest chain and a short property or relationship task, then save before traveling onward.

title: Lost Odyssey
dailyChunk: Finish one dungeon section or boss, read one unlocked dream, and save at the next checkpoint.

title: Tearaway
dailyChunk: Finish one paper-crafted chapter, find two hidden presents, and stop at the next scrapbook transition.

title: Gravity Rush
dailyChunk: Complete one story mission and one gravity-race challenge, then return to a safe district.

title: The Witness
dailyChunk: Solve one complete panel-puzzle cluster and note the rule you learned before moving to another region.

title: Nioh 2
dailyChunk: Finish one mission or sub-mission, sort Yokai Soul Cores and loot, and stop at the shrine/menu.

title: Animal Well
dailyChunk: Explore one new puzzle path and make a small note of unresolved mysteries before saving.

title: Sea of Stars
dailyChunk: Reach one story camp or boss checkpoint, explore for a nearby treasure, and save.
